message.scp_unleashed.z0002.space: There is no room for it here.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.z0002_finger.1: Z-0002 is a Z-Class object. Z-Class objects never turn up in the archive. This one can only be bought through the Shop app on a facility computer, and it arrives with its file.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.z0002_finger.2: Those who have seen it pointed describe dark water, a shrine that breathes and a black sky closing overhead. None of them agree on how long it lasted.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.z0002_finger.3: Do not point it at anyone you want to keep.

dossier.scp_unleashed.z0002.title: The Red Finger
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0002.caption: Z-0002 as delivered, resting on the cushion from its box.
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0002.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
Z-0002 is not held at any Foundation site. It is supplied through the facility network on request, and responsibility for it passes to whoever makes the request. %rThe listing was added on a day the network was offline.%r
Z-0002 is to be kept in its box, away from occupied areas and away from anyone with a reason to be angry. It may be held in a standard storage locker.
**Z-0002 is not to be pointed at anyone.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0002.page.1.title: Description:
Z-0002 is a single withered finger about the length of a pen, dried hard and twisted like old vine. Its surface is rose to deep crimson, knotted with ridges and small hollows, and it ends in a long dark nail. The base is split into fine dry strands.
Z-0002 does not decay, and it is never quite as cold as the room it is kept in. Staff who hold it for long report the feeling of being looked down on from a great height.
When Z-0002 is pointed with intent, everyone nearby hears the same two phrases spoken in the same voice. What follows is described in the addenda.
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0002.page.2.title: Addendum Z-0002-1: Test Log
Test Z-11: a researcher pointed Z-0002 across an empty test hall. Everyone in the hall and in the observation gallery heard the same words and then could not be found. Less than a minute later they were standing where they had been, unharmed and badly shaken. The hall was exactly as it had been.
Test Z-12: the same researcher tried again the next morning. Nothing happened. Later attempts that day also failed.
Test Z-13: two D-Class subjects were present when Z-0002 was pointed. %rOne returned.%r Testing suspended by order of the Site Director.
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0002.page.3.title: Addendum Z-0002-2: Witness Statement
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0002.page.3.text: "It went dark, and there was water under us that did not move, and something like a temple was breathing. Every time he lifted his hand the air split open. I kept looking for a way out. There was a wall. It was black, and it was everywhere."
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0002.page.4.title: Addendum Z-0002-3: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0002.page.4.text: Z-0002 has no recovery record. Like Z-0001, it appeared in the facility network's supply listings without an entry from any department. It arrives in a lacquered box lined with dark velvet. The box has no maker's mark.
